title: Private Event & Banquet Services: Service Charge, Staffing Ratios and Floor Rates
content:
What an event costs in people is set by four figures printed against its Private Event & Banquet Services package — the service charge, the ratio the room is staffed to, the rate each service hour is billed at and the hours the package already includes — together with the threshold at which licensed security is required and the rate it is billed at.

| Package | Service charge on food and beverage, per cent | Guests per service staff member | Service staff rate, USD per hour | Service hours included | Service hour beyond the included hours, USD | Guest count above which licensed security is required | Security rate, USD per hour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 34 | 0.0 | 51 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 18 | 25 | 36 | 2.0 | 54 | 0 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 20 | 20 | 38 | 4.0 | 57 | 150 | 46 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 22 | 16 | 42 | 5.0 | 63 | 250 | 52 |
| Gala Reception Package | 24 | 12 | 48 | 6.0 | 72 | 400 | 58 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 21 | 18 | 40 | 10.0 | 60 | 500 | 55 |

The service charge column is the service charge added to food and beverage, as a percentage. The ratio column is the guests per service staff member the package is staffed to. The two rate columns are the billed rate for each service staff hour and the billed rate for each service hour beyond the included hours. The included hours column is the on-site service hours included in the package. The last two columns are the guest count above which licensed security staff are required and the billed rate for each security staff hour.

## Reading the figures together

A smaller figure in the ratio column is a more heavily staffed room: the Gala Reception Package is staffed at 12 guests to each member of service staff and the Boardroom Reception Package at 25. The Meeting Room Refreshment Package prints 0 in that column, and 0 in the service charge, included hours and security columns as well.

Two packages require no licensed security at any guest count, printing 0 in the threshold and rate columns alike — the Meeting Room Refreshment Package and the Boardroom Reception Package. Above them the threshold climbs from 150 guests on the Conference Day Delegate Package to 500 on the Multi-Day Conference Residency Package, whose security rate of 55 sits below the 58 printed against the Gala Reception Package.

The rate beyond the included hours runs half as much again as the service staff rate on every package: 34 and 51 on the Meeting Room Refreshment Package, 42 and 63 on the Seated Banquet Package, 48 and 72 on the Gala Reception Package.
